name: Orlândia (Brazil)
description: Horizontal bicolour of blue over red, charged at the centre with a white simplified outline map of São Paulo state bearing the municipal arms.
history: Orlândia is a municipality in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag was prescribed by Municipal Law No. 867, adopted for the 64th anniversary of the town: blue recalls the landscapes and mild climate and red the pioneers.

features.role: simplified map of São Paulo state bearing the municipal arms
municipal arms with a mural crown
